Rubidium and strontium are both in Period 5 of the Periodic Table.
Rubidium is in Group I. Strontium is in Group II.
Which statement about these elements is correct?
A
Each element has five electrons in its outer electron shell.
B
The atomic number of rubidium is greater than the atomic number of strontium.
Rubidium forms the Rb+ion; strontium forms the Sr2+ion.
C
Electrolysisofmoltenrubidiumchlorideand of moltenstrontiumchlorideproduces
D
hydrogen.
